u0: At the start, nothing has been accomplished: the ball still blocks the door, the door is closed, the matching key is not yet in hand, and the box is not carried. The agent must first move the ball out of the way, and only then take the matching key, since taking the key before the ball is moved breaks a requirement. After acquiring the key the door can be opened, and only then can the target box be picked up to finish.
u1: This is a failure state: a mandatory requirement has been violated, either the key was taken before the ball was out of the way, or the door was opened or the box picked up before its prerequisite was met. Successful completion is no longer possible from here.
u2: The blocking ball has been moved out of the way of the door, and the agent does not yet carry the door key. The door must still be opened from the far side of the ball's former cell, so the matching key must be acquired next, after which the door can be unlocked and the box picked up.
u3: The blocking ball has been moved out of the way and the agent is carrying the matching door key, with the door still closed. The remaining work is to open the door and then pick up the mission's target box; the key will need to be released first, since carrying it prevents picking up the box.
u4: The door is open and the agent still holds the matching key. The final objective is to pick up the mission's designated box, which first requires putting the key down so the hands are free. Pursuing this path, no key-loss failure occurs because the door is already open.
u5: All requirements have been satisfied: the ball was moved, the key was acquired afterward, the door was opened, and the mission's target box has been picked up. The task is complete.
